# SD18 deterministic Human Cleric level 12 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Cleric
# level-1..level-11 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_cleric_level11_sd18_widening_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 12 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-11 fixtures, and the
# same canonical domain selections (Good, Healing), adding only the level
# bump this bounded slice needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Cleric burden surface: no spellbook, no
# spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, no domain
# power execution beyond the flat facets already grounded at levels 1-11, no
# domain spell-list contents, and no level-13+ progression. The PF1 CRB
# Cleric class table's level-12 "Special" column is genuinely BLANK
# (verified independently against both d20pfsrd and Archives of Nethys
# aonprd.com), so no new class feature is gained at 12th level; base attack
# bonus genuinely rises to +9 (12 * 3 / 4), base Fortitude/Will (good saves)
# genuinely rise to +8 (12 / 2 + 2), base Reflex (poor save) genuinely rises
# to +4 (12 / 3), and the Good domain's Touch of Good sacred bonus genuinely
# rises to 6 (12 / 2); Channel Energy's die count stays 6d6 ((12 + 1) / 2 = 6,
# unchanged from level 11 — the die count only rises at odd cleric levels)
# and the domain spell slot count stays 6 (a level-12 cleric still casts only
# up to 6th-level cleric spells — 7th-level cleric spells first appear at
# level 13), so no new pillar is grounded at level 12 either — only the
# existing pillars are widened.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-cleric-level12
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:cleric:12
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:good
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:healing
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
